description: Caption preprocessing for image retrieval and indexing. Original reference captions are preserved unchanged.

caption_field_definitions.raw_reference_captions: Original captions preserved exactly for evaluation.
caption_field_definitions.cleaned_retrieval_captions: Cleaned captions intended for retrieval and indexing.
caption_field_definitions.retrieval_tokens: Tokenized cleaned captions intended for retrieval and indexing.

evaluation_policy: Evaluation must use raw_reference_captions, never cleaned_retrieval_captions or retrieval_tokens.
